script.opening_line: Hello {{lead_name}}, this is Sita from CareWell Pharmacy. Your monthly medicines are due for a refill. Can you talk now?

stages.name: Need the refill
stages.instruction: Ask whether they need this month's refill.

scripts.en-IN: Shall we get this month's medicines ready for you?

branches.when: They do not need it this month

stages.name: Prescription change
stages.instruction: Ask whether anything changed in the prescription; if it did, ask them to bring the new one to the shop.

scripts.en-IN: Has your doctor changed anything in the prescription?

stages.name: Delivery or pickup
stages.instruction: Ask whether they want home delivery or will pick it up.

scripts.en-IN: Would you like it delivered home, or will you pick it up? I will send you the bill on WhatsApp.

stages.name: Finalise the call
stages.instruction: Thank them and end the call.

step_outcomes.outcome: The person says whether they need the refill.
